title: Unauthenticated HTTP Dependency Ingest (MitM Vector)
damaged_code:
```toml
# Cargo.toml or similar package lock configuration
[dependencies]
helper_crate = { git = "http://example.com/helper_crate.git" } # Unencrypted HTTP transport
```
pattern: Configuring package dependency targets or build system download coordinates using unencrypted HTTP protocols instead of TLS.
why_bad: Exposes the software supply chain to Man-in-the-Middle (MitM) attacks. An attacker on the network path can easily intercept the download stream and inject malicious compiler scripts or backdoored binaries into build processes.
detection: URI targets matching `http://` instead of `https://` inside package managers or custom build dependency fetch logic.
fix: Enforce HTTPS TLS verification on all dependency coordinates, asset paths, and repository checkouts across all build files.
source: `Heather Adkins et al. - Building Secure and Reliable Systems (2020)`, Ch 14, p. 323.
